entries.en: Anderson? What are you doing here?
Commander? I don't know what the captain did, but all our systems just came back online.
entries.tr: Komutan? Kaptan ne yaptı bilmiyorum ama tüm sistemlerimiz birden geri geldi.

entries.en: Let's go. Get us out of here, Joker. Now!
entries.tr: Gidelim. Bizi buradan çıkar, Joker. Hemen!
